ability.agent.name: AI & Remote
label.MCP / Remote 接入、访问令牌、已连接会话与隐私策略: MCP / Remote access, token, connected sessions and privacy policy
label.开关 MCP / Remote，管理令牌与会话: Toggle MCP / Remote, manage token and sessions
agent.token_regenerated: Regenerated — the old token no longer works
agent.running_flag: Running (enabled by launch flag, this run only)
agent.intro: When enabled, local AI (MCP clients) or scripts can read the UI, click and run commands. Private data is masked for them by default and needs your approval in a consent window. The services listen on 127.0.0.1 only and require an access token.
agent.mcp_desc: For MCP clients such as Claude Code (Streamable HTTP)
agent.remote_desc: For your own scripts: POST /rpc, method names match the MCP tools
agent.enable: Enable in settings (applies on every launch)
agent.flag_hint: Or enable for this run only: pnpm dev -- {flag}
agent.token_desc: Stored in ~/.config/LinuxCockpit/agent/token (owner-readable only). Regenerate it immediately if it leaks.
agent.policy_personal: Personal data (Bilibili uid, listening history, logs… — not linkable to a real person)
agent.policy_control: Changing system state (services / containers, wallpaper, autostart…)
agent.policy_note: Sensitive data (student ID, balances, locations…) always needs your approval in the consent window; credentials such as passwords and API keys are never given to AI.
agent.regen_body: The old token stops working immediately and connected AI / scripts are disconnected; reconnect them with the new token.
agent.ui_desc: How the UI shows that an AI is operating: title-bar avatars, window outline, hover details. The AI cannot change these.
agent.ui_show_bar: Show AI avatars in the title bar
agent.ui_outline: Outline the window while an AI operates
agent.ui_tooltip: Show page / status / last action on hover
agent.ui_avatar: Accept avatars supplied by the AI
agent.ui_busy_hint: How long after its last call an AI counts as operating; the outline fades with it
agent.ui_status_ttl_hint: How long a set_status message stays visible
agent.ui_hide_idle_hint: Remove an idle AI from the bar after this long; 0 = never
agent.ui_isolate: Let the AI work in its own view (leave my window alone)
agent.ui_screenshot_hint: Auto: use the flicker-free method first, and fall back to the reliable one when an occluded window makes it fail (a transparent window may flash once)
agent.ui_screenshot_capture: Copy frame (no flash; may fail when the window is occluded)
agent.ui_follow_inplace: Follow inside the main window (a Back button returns to my UI)
